🔄 Content Update (Published October 16, 2026 / Previously listed October 1, 2026)
Main change: Special consultation sessions have ended.

Administrative consultation handles inquiries and requests about government agency procedures and systems—things like "I don't understand," "I'm not satisfied with the explanation," or "I think there might be a mistake in how this was processed."

【Regular Consultation (Citizens' General Consultation)】
Specialist advisors—including lawyers, judicial scriveners, administrative consultation commissioners, and human rights advocates—provide guidance on life problems and problem-solving. For details, see the Hanno City Social Welfare Council website under "Citizens' General Consultation."

【Special Consultation (Ended)】
During the "Administrative Consultation Month" (September 1 – October 31, 2026), temporary administrative consultation offices were planned.
• Seimei District Administrative Center: Monday, September 7, 2026, 10 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1–3 p.m.
• Minami-Kōmae District Administrative Center: Thursday, October 15, 2026, 10 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1–3 p.m.
Consultation is free and confidential. (These sessions have already passed.)

【Other Consultation】
The Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications Kanto Regional Bureau for Administrative Evaluation offers an administrative consultation hotline (phone 0570-090-110, fax 048-600-2336).

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/jinkenkurashianzen/kurashi/11813.html
